coverage.runtime: Not measured: correctness-only construction; no timing, calibration, A/A, A/B, optimization or model spend. Same six-group/128-process batch shape, comparable original byte volume, and unchanged task options. No minimum-runtime claim from this work.

heldout_construction.distribution: Held-out input bodies and the six expected-output bodies are not redistributed. Inputs are fetched from crates.io's pinned index and outputs are regenerated locally, both authenticated by SHA-256 before scoring; see docs/serde-json-verifier-recovery.md and notices/CRATES-IO-INDEX.md.
heldout_construction.fetch_only_ruling: Held-out inputs are fetch-only from the pinned crates.io index commit; no crates.io index bytes are committed. The six expected outputs generated by the pristine library are not stored in Git or Git LFS; they are regenerated from the pinned inputs with tools/recover_serde_json_goldens.py and must match the SHA-256 commitments in tests/heldout.lock.json.
heldout_construction.independence: The held-out builder had not seen any serde_json agent solution, patch or trace and did not read experiments, scoring/baseline evidence, or solver records.
heldout_construction.owner_decision: Decision (2026-10-25): serde_json receives the same held-out structure as the other tasks (held-out manifest and references in this repository, built to the specification below), as a recorded one-time exception to the usual order in which held-out construction follows headroom confirmation.

reference_generation.canonicalization: Unchanged protected task.strict_loads and runner.canonical_json; object-key order and JSON escape spelling are the only ignored presentation differences.

rights_evidence.generated_expected: Pristine-generated complete canonical expected outputs (six files, 2,748,152 bytes) are not redistributed; they are regenerated locally from the pinned inputs. Source input bodies are never retained.
rights_evidence.no_license_inference: Crate code licenses and policy-text CC-BY do not establish a blanket registry-metadata redistribution license. Inputs remain fetch-only: users download them from the crates.io index under its terms.

heldout_construction.selection: Six frozen independent repository/maintenance families; original complete histories; no mutations; same pinned registry source as public; no crate/version/checksum/full-record overlap.
